title: W05 to W03 Owned Post Context Binding

caller.authority: Reply-audience policy, profile-pin state, notification recipient routing, share-link validation, favorite relations and social relationship state

callee.authority: Canonical content ownership, type and lifecycle in D1-02

principal.source: W01 authenticated server principal; never from public request body

forbidden: client-provided ownerUserId in mutation body or principal headers

publicProfileRead.subjectOwnerIdSource: Validated target user ID from the public profile route; it is not asserted as the authenticated caller
publicProfileRead.constraint: W03 returns only the requested owner's PUBLISHED post and only the minimal public context fields

failClosed: public profile target owner does not own the referenced post

inScope: Owner-only reply-audience GET uses W03 for canonical post context and W05 for reply policy state.
Reply-audience PUT obtains owner/type/lifecycle context from W03 before W05 writes only the W05-owned reply policy table.
Profile-pin POST obtains owner/type/lifecycle context from W03 before W05 writes only social_profile_pins.
Public pinned-content GET reads only the W05 pin reference and validates published owner/type/lifecycle through W03 before returning it.
W05 content-like and root-comment notification recipient lookup resolves the canonical owner through W03; notification relationships and events remain W05-owned.
Share creation and resolution read or write W05-owned social_share_links only; W03's published-content context is the authority for current target publication state.
The W05 content social summary reads canonical publication/type/owner context through W03; counts, viewer interaction state, topics, mentions and profile-pin references remain W05-owned.
Content hashtag/mention synchronization gets canonical published state and owner from W03; W05 continues to own social topic/mention edges.
GET content token reads validate the target's published state through W03 before reading W05-owned topic/mention metadata.
Poll configuration and draft-poll deletion obtain canonical post owner/type/lifecycle through the existing W03 owned-post context before W05 reads or writes poll tables.
Repost creation validates canonical published content and owner through W03_CONTENT, checks block relationships in W05-owned social_user_interactions, and writes only social_reposts.

Favorite creation and status validate canonical publication through W03_CONTENT; W05 reads and writes only interaction_favorites, and the local status cache is consulted only after W03 confirms the target is published.

Poll vote submission reads the W05-owned poll record to get its expected owner, asks W03's existing published-owner-post context to verify that the canonical target is currently a PUBLISHED post owned by that user, then keeps block, vote-window and duplicate-vote checks within W05-owned tables. The final W05 vote INSERT checks W05-owned poll identity/owner, vote window, Block and duplicate-vote state only; it does not query canonical contents.

W05 poll result GET validates canonical published post context through W03_CONTENT before reading W05 poll tables; if public lookup returns 404, an authenticated owner may use the existing owner-scoped context to preview their draft poll.

W05 like creation and status validate content publication through the existing W03 published-social context before non-atomic preflight, block checks or cache use; comment likes obtain author/parent IDs from social_comments and parent publication/owner from W03.

W05 content-liker list GET validates the target's canonical published state/owner through W03_CONTENT, then reads only W05 interaction_likes and social_user_interactions for paging and Block filtering.

W05 profile-replies collects bounded candidate comment IDs from social_comments, resolves their currently published parent-content owner/state in one W03_CONTENT batch, and retains W05-owned Block/Mute filtering and cursor pagination without joining canonical contents. W05 profile-liked-content lists collect bounded target IDs from interaction_likes, resolve published owner/state in one W03_CONTENT batch, and apply W05-owned Block/Mute filtering without joining canonical contents. W05 comment-list GET validates the target's currently published state through the existing W03 published-social-context binding before reading W05-owned social_comments, likes and block/mute relations; the list SQL does not join canonical contents.

W05 comment PATCH and DELETE load comment-owned metadata from social_comments, validate the parent content's current PUBLISHED state through getPublishedContentSocialContext, and keep author/state/version/leaf-reply guards in W05 without querying canonical contents; an existing author-deleted tombstone remains an idempotent delete success without requiring current publication context.

W05 topic-page reads page only W05-owned social_target_topics IDs and resolves currently published state, type, title and updatedAt for each bounded batch through W03_CONTENT; W05 issues no canonical contents JOIN and skips stale/unpublished topic edges.
outOfScope: Comment insertion's atomic content-state/policy recheck remains unchanged.
Comment insertion's atomic W05 policy, block and publication rechecks still query canonical content state within the existing transaction.
Cross-Worker publication changes cannot be transactionally locked with a W05 share-link write; every share resolution revalidates through W03 and denies unpublished or missing content.
A W03 publication change cannot be transactionally locked with a W05 repost insert; feed/read paths must independently revalidate canonical visibility before disclosing repost targets.

Cross-Worker publication changes cannot be transactionally locked with a W05 favorite insert; a stale relation may remain after unpublish but status reads return false and do not disclose unpublished content.

Publication can change after W03 validates a poll read or vote attempt but before W05 completes its mutation; W03 and W05 cannot share a transaction, so the final vote INSERT cannot atomically recheck canonical publication state. Each public poll read and vote attempt revalidates through W03, but a narrow unpublish race can still permit a vote write against stale W05 poll metadata.
The final W05 like INSERT retains its existing single-statement canonical content publication and block rechecks for race safety; W03 and W05 cannot share a transaction across Workers.
The publication state may change after W03 validates a content-liker list request because W03 and W05 cannot share a read transaction; the next request revalidates through W03.

Publication may change after W03 returns a profile-replies batch because W03 and W05 cannot share a read transaction; every profile-replies page revalidates parent content IDs through W03. Publication may change after W03 validates a comment-list GET and before W05 reads comments; the next GET revalidates canonical publication through W03.

Canonical publication can change after W03 validates a comment edit/delete because the Workers cannot share a transaction; W05 mutation guards remain local to social_comments and subsequent reads revalidate current published visibility.

W05 trending discovery-topic aggregation (`listDiscoveryTopics`) remains a separate read-model slice and is not changed by this topic-page closure. Comment creation's atomic policy/publication recheck and the content-like final INSERT retain their existing direct canonical reads for race protection.

W05 public pinned-content GET reads W05 pin state only and asks W03 to validate public visibility
W05 public pinned-content GET returns null for stale or unpublished pins and fails closed when W03 is unavailable
W03 published-content social context returns only ID, owner, type and PUBLISHED state
W05 content-like notification owner lookup uses W03 and does not query contents for recipient resolution
W05 root-comment notification owner lookup uses W03 while parent-comment notifications remain based on W05-owned social_comments
W05 share creation and resolution call W03 published-content context without Authorization/Cookie forwarding and do not query contents directly.
W05 content social summary uses W03_CONTENT for published-content validation, fails closed when unavailable and issues no direct contents-table query.
W05 content token synchronization resolves owner/publication through W03, fails closed when context is missing, and does not query the canonical contents table.
W05 content token GET checks W03 publication before W05 D1 reads and fails closed for missing W03 binding or unpublished content.
W05 poll configure/delete use W03 owned-post context, forward only validated principal/correlation metadata and perform no direct contents-table validation.

W05 repost creation validates published state through W03 without forwarding Authorization/Cookie, preserves W05 block checks, writes only social_reposts, and fails closed before W05 D1 access if W03 is unavailable or the target is unpublished.

W05 favorite creation/status call W03 published-content context without forwarding Authorization/Cookie, query only interaction_favorites in W05, fail closed if W03 is unavailable, and invalidate/avoid cached true state for unpublished content.

W05 castContentPollVote calls the W03 published-owner-post context, forwards only W05 caller/correlation metadata, uses W05 social poll/relationship tables only, preserves block/window/single-vote guards, and fails without inserting when W03 is missing or the canonical post is unpublished or owned by another user.
W05 poll result GET validates published visibility through W03, preserves owner-only draft preview fallback, fails closed on missing binding, and performs no direct canonical contents read.

W05 like POST/GET use W03 published-social context without forwarding Authorization/Cookie; status cache is consulted only after canonical visibility and W05 block checks; content status reads only W05 interaction_likes; comment status reads W05 social_comments then W03 parent context.
W05 content-liker list uses W03 published-social-context without Authorization/Cookie forwarding and performs no direct canonical contents query in its W05 list SQL.

W05 profile-replies batch call carries only W05 caller/version/correlation headers, contains at most 50 IDs, does not forward Authorization/Cookie, filters missing/unpublished parents, preserves W05 Block/Mute rules, and performs no direct canonical contents query. W05 profile-liked-content list batches at most 50 liked content IDs through W03, filters missing/unpublished targets and owner Block/Mute relations in W05, preserves cursor scoping, and performs no direct canonical contents query. W05 comment-list GET calls W03 published-social-context before D1, forwards only W05 caller/version/correlation metadata without Authorization/Cookie, fails closed when W03 is missing or content is unpublished, preserves recursive comment order/cursors and viewer Block/Mute filtering, and performs no canonical contents query.

W05 comment PATCH/DELETE use getPublishedContentSocialContext through W03_CONTENT without Authorization/Cookie forwarding, fail closed when the binding is missing or content is unpublished, preserve author/version/leaf-reply/tombstone behavior, and perform no direct canonical contents-table query.

W05 topic-page read takes a bounded W05 topic-edge batch, calls the existing W03 published-social-context-batch without forwarding credentials, renders canonical titles/types/timestamps from W03, filters unpublished/missing content, uses an opaque W05 topic-edge cursor, fails closed when W03 is missing, and issues no canonical contents SQL.

operations.purpose: Resolve a bounded set of content publication/type/owner contexts for social profile reply visibility without one W03 round trip per reply. The batch also returns the public title field needed to render topic-page content cards without a W05 direct contents join.
